evidence: Claude whole-plugin activation is bounded by the exact provider tuple, matching manifest identity, provider-visible inventory with a deliberately narrower default one-level skills/<name>/SKILL.md activation surface, action-time requalification, negative tests, and exact-provider E2E before release.
Full locked tests, focused negative tests, fuzz smoke, and release-readiness checks are required.
cap-std/cap-primitives 4.0.3 delta is lockfile-pinned and covered by Dependency Review plus cargo-deny.
Pinned Actions changes are reviewed by whole-release delta, CodeQL, public-boundary and release workflows.
v0.4.0 version identity, artifact qualification, SBOM/provenance, draft-only release workflow, executable local release helpers, and truthful pre-tag smoke evidence are machine gated.
README/docs/SECURITY/changelog are reviewed against implementation and publication state; false release claims block acceptance.

near_misses.durable_control: Provider inventory may observe broader Claude plugin surfaces, but v0.4.0 activation requires matching manifest identity plus only the default one-level skills/<name>/SKILL.md surface; slash commands and every other non-skill surface fail closed, and release requires behavior-specific exact-provider evidence.
Clean-launch and plugin-activation exact qualification tuples are separate and regression-tested.

Release identity/date is checked again at the action-time tag boundary; changelog date must match the annotated tagger date, and the tagger-timestamp parser is regression-tested against the real digit format.
This contract binds every release to the authoritative latest published stable release and classifies the whole delta fail-closed.

Semantic review is sealed to a SHA-256 digest of every tracked mode/type/blob/path, with the review declaration represented by canonical semantics that exclude only the self-referential digest field; any later code/docs/workflow/release-script or review-semantic drift fails closed.
Tag workflow extracts the exact release archive and runs real-provider qualification against the archived clroom-codex and clroom-claude binaries.
Tag workflow explicitly verifies the exported SBOM attestation bundle against the exact archive before Draft Release creation.
Stable tag helper requires exact accepted-main pre-tag plugin smoke evidence before creating the protected annotated v* tag; Draft bytes are exercised again before publication.
The candidate seal includes canonical semantics of the release review declaration itself, excluding only the self-referential digest field.
Whole-release path inventory disables rename detection so a move is classified at both the deleted old path and the added new path.
Release workflow contract test now requires archive extraction, exact archive-root provider binaries, and explicitly rejects sibling target/* provider candidates.

Activation re-runs install-root, manifest identity, component-surface, selection, and qualification inspection immediately before launch; nested, symlinked, unreadable, identity-mismatched, or newly introduced non-skill surfaces fail closed with regression coverage.
Release readiness now requires executable mode on the documented direct-run local release audit and plugin activation smoke helpers, so mode drift fails before merge/tag.

Smoke evidence distinguishes the fixed automated sentinel prompt from the separately confirmed no-prompt interactive TUI check; the tag gate validates those truthful fields instead of asserting that no prompt was supplied anywhere.

artifact_capability_gates.requirement: Build an exact accepted-main candidate archive on macOS Apple Silicon with an already-installed qualified skill-only Claude plugin; prove clean absence, selected presence, no newly admitted sibling, no plugin errors, unchanged persistent provider config, and normal selected-plugin interactive TUI startup without a model prompt.

Download the exact Draft Release archive on macOS Apple Silicon with an already-installed qualified skill-only Claude plugin; verify checksums and both release attestation bundles, then prove clean absence, selected presence, no newly admitted sibling, no plugin errors, and unchanged persistent provider config.

product_outcome: Ship the bounded Claude skill-only whole-plugin activation and the post-v0.3.1 security/maintenance delta without widening CLROOM trust boundaries or weakening the existing clean-launch contract.

contract_evolution_review.rationale: v0.4.0 review exposed repeated gaps where existing CI could pass while release-wide semantic scope, exact shipped bytes, or an exported attestation bundle were not independently bound. These are recurring release failure modes and are promoted to deterministic gates.
promoted_controls: whole-release delta classification from the latest published stable immutable release
exact tracked-content semantic review digest including canonical review-declaration semantics and excluding only the self-referential digest field
mandatory per-release contract-evolution decision with durable controls
real-provider qualification against binaries extracted from the exact release archive
explicit verification of the exported SBOM attestation bundle
exact accepted-main plugin capability smoke evidence required before protected tag creation
rename-safe whole-release path classification that evaluates both old and new paths
negative release workflow contract test forbidding provider qualification against sibling build outputs
action-time plugin install-root, manifest-identity, component-surface and qualification revalidation with fail-closed drift tests
executable-mode readiness checks for documented direct-run release audit and plugin smoke helpers
truthful smoke evidence separating automated sentinel-prompt probes from manual no-prompt TUI confirmation
annotated-tagger date parser regression coverage for the local protected-tag helper
